svg.title: Implemented S4 - all nine patterns, atomic commits and post-commit delivery

g.text: Implemented S4 - all nine patterns, atomic commits and post-commit delivery
events() snapshot in global commit order
apply(code, ID, epoch millis, zone, rN, event ID)
Confirm/cancel/complete/reschedule operate on latest stored Appointment.
State delegates eligibility and immutable replacement.
Same event/delivery path follows each successful mutation.
External conflicts warn after commit; local repository owns collision prevention.
No callbacks hold the repository mutation lock. Console calls this facade.
